⚖️ Supreme Court on Commercial Arbitration: Can You Challenge an Arbitration Clause After Consenting?

The Supreme Court, in M/s Eminent Colonizers Private Limited v. Rajasthan Housing Board & Ors., reaffirmed an important principle under the pre-2015 Arbitration Act: a party that has consented to the appointment of an arbitrator by the Court cannot later dispute the existence or validity of the arbitration agreement.**

**Key Legal Takeaways:**

✔️ **Principle of Estoppel:** Once you consent to the appointment of an arbitrator, you are bound by that decision.

✔️ **No Subsequent Challenge:** You cannot later question the arbitration clause before the arbitral tribunal or in proceedings under **Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996**.

✔️ **Commercial Certainty:** The judgment reinforces procedural finality, party autonomy, and certainty in commercial dispute resolution.

The Supreme Court, in ***Mohammad Wajid v. State of Uttar Pradesh (2023)***, reaffirmed an important principle of criminal law: **criminal antecedents alone cannot be the sole ground for refusing to quash criminal proceedings.**

featured_reviews.name: Harmehak Kaur Anand
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience at Divekar and Co. has been deeply enriching and insightful. featured_reviews.name: Berjes Shroff
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best, most ethical and helpful Law firm I've come across. We were in the process of selling our old property and buying new property, and we had engaged Divekar & Co. for both deals. The thorough and deep groundwork done by Dr. Pallavi Divekar actually made our Builder comment that they've never come across such a law firm that investigates and digs so deep into every aspect of the property deal. This was the 2nd time we had engaged Divekar & Co. for a property deal, and we would strongly recommend it to anyone. We are extremely happy with their "service with a smile" and personal touch.

featured_reviews.review_text: M/s Divekar & Co brings in 102 years of experience by their Partners and the Associates. The firm and its staff ensures that everyone walks away with something learnt. featured_reviews.review_text: An all service Solicitor firm, Divekar and Company is traditional yet progressive. Offers a balanced legal advise keeping clients interest as paramount. Simple things such as  responsiveness and and easy approachability, makes it a pleasant experience for the client who feels reassured. It has been a very delightful experience for me as work with Divekar &, Co as our leagl advisors.

featured_reviews.name: Meenal Chaukar
featured_reviews.review_text: When looking for counsel on a personal matter, I connected with Divekar & Co. through my network. Was well guided by Dr. Pallavi Divekar and my experience was extremely positive – not only does Pallavi have a sound understanding of the Law (and can explain it in simple terms), but most importantly, she can provide a practical, workable resolution. I also appreciated her personal engagement and empathetic approach.

featured_reviews.name: Priti Gaikwad
featured_reviews.review_text: Divekar and Co. have a great legacy of 100 years and it reflects beautifully in the way they help resolve issues and provide legal advice. I had consulted them regarding an affidavit for some important missing documentation. They not only helped me understand the legal process to recover these, they provided a full proof document to submit my application. They are trustworthy, dependable and have done a stellar job in securing justice for those who do not have the means to speak for themselves. I admire their work in providing relief for housing societies and individuals who have had to pursue a legal course due to unavoidable circumstances. I wholeheartedly recommend everyone with legal issues to consult them without hesitation and seek the best advice and outcome for their troubles.
